coverage.main: Read all fourteen pages of arXiv 2309.14700v1 (Sections 1-5, Algorithm 1, Tables 1-3, Figures 1-11, references, Appendix A) and the thirteen-page ICCV 2023 open-access version; all 156 one-decimal values match between versions.
coverage.supplement: Appendix A (transformation implementation details) is embedded in the arXiv PDF and read; it contains no results.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box (source) bars in Figure 3. Table 1's LPIPS column is a similarity measure. Figures 1-2 and Table 2 are illustrations.

result_groups.population: 1,000 ILSVRC 2012 validation images, one per category, 'correctly classified by the adopted models'; single-model, SGM/LinBP-integrated, ensemble and ablation settings with eight CNN/transformer victims
result_groups.outcome: attack success rate: 'the misclassification rates of the victim model on the crafted adversarial examples'
result_groups.evidence: The images are explicitly restricted to those the adopted (normally trained) models classify correctly. The success-rate definition is a bare outcome definition, with no statement retaining or removing source failures.

result_groups.population: Same 1,000 images; examples generated on all eight models simultaneously; Inc-v3ens/IncRes-v2ens, HGD, R&P, NIPS-r3, FD, JPEG, Bit-Red, RS and NRP
result_groups.evidence: It is not stated whether the defended models are among the 'adopted models' used for the correctness filter.

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy is printed; correctness is used only as a filter.

f2.evidence: The normal-model scope is explicitly clean-correct (yes); the defense scope is unresolved. Positive conditioning evidence.

f3.evidence: No source-success rule or explicit inclusion statement.

f4.evidence: Most results are bar charts; the tabulated values are averages over victims (Table 3, Figure 8) or a single cell (Table 1) without a stated count.

f5.evidence: MI-FGSM-based attacks with epsilon = 16 (L-infinity, sign-step), T = 10, for all experiments.

f6.evidence: The official repository provides SIA and an evaluator on torchvision models with weights='DEFAULT'. Images come from the Admix Drive folder. Default torchvision weights may differ from those used in 2023, and defenses are not included. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Linked in the paper. Listed via the GitHub API (6 files, head 23 February 2024): attack.py, main.py, utils.py. The main.py --eval branch counts, for each listed torchvision model, adversarial images whose prediction equals the label over all saved images (accuracy; source failures retained). As pinned, the non-eval branch's post-attack loop instantiates the source model for every entry. Artifact evidence only; not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: Rates are over images all adopted models classify correctly, so no unconditional matched bound applies.
No clean accuracy for defended models.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. Figure values were not digitised.
